hypotheses.P1_downstream_rank_collapse: Median final-state rank90 is at most 75% of median local-write rank90 across the 12 selected axes.
hypotheses.P2_low_dimensional_final_roles: Four components capture at least 0.75 median final-state role energy.
hypotheses.P3_depth_concentrates_each_group: Final first-role energy exceeds local first-role energy in every predeclared axis group.
hypotheses.P4_effects_reach_predictions: Across selected sites, median next-token KL is at least 1e-6 and median absolute correct-token logit change is at least 0.01.
hypotheses.P5_not_every_axis_is_rank1: At least three selected axes retain final-state rank90 of at least 4.
